Gary Neal is 41 years old.

Gary Neal made at least $10,813,777 playing professional basketball.

Gary Neal averaged 9.9 points, 2.2 rebounds, and 1.6 assists per game.

Gary Neal won 0 championships.

Gary Neal attended Calvert Hall in Towson, Maryland, La Salle and Towson University.
